name: Metawork - Antique Shop Simulator
detailed_description:
About the Game

Welcome to Antique Shop Simulator, a deep and immersive tycoon experience where you build your legacy as a master antique dealer. From humble beginnings in a small, dusty shop to owning a high-end showroom filled with rare treasures, every decision you make shapes your journey.

Run Your Own Antique Shop

Start with a modest storefront and work your way up by buying and selling second-hand items, rare collectibles, and valuable antiques. You’ll need a good eye for quality and a sharper mind for business. Track item conditions, research their histories, and make calculated decisions—will you sell it now or invest in repairs for greater profits later?

Restore Forgotten Treasures

Some antiques come in poor condition, but hidden beneath the dust may lie a gem. Use your workshop to clean, repair, and restore furniture, old electronics, vintage decorations, and more. Improve their value and attract collectors willing to pay top dollar.

Explore and Expand

Unlock new areas on the map—from estate sales in the countryside to secret warehouse auctions in the city. These locations offer new types of goods, rare items, and valuable opportunities. As your business grows, invest in a larger shop, hire staff, and optimize your operations to handle the booming demand.

Dynamic Customer Interactions

Every day, different customers will walk through your door: collectors, tourists, bargain hunters, and eccentric treasure seekers. Read their behavior, negotiate skillfully, and tailor your offers. Some may even bring you special requests or high-stakes offers that can make or break your reputation.

Build Your Reputation

Word spreads fast in the antique world. Deliver quality service, make smart deals, and handle special requests to build your shop's reputation. A respected name means more customers, better offers, and exclusive deals.

Secure Your Investment

Not all attention is good. As your shop becomes more successful, you’ll become a target for thieves. Protect your collection by installing advanced security systems, hiring guards, and reviewing surveillance footage to catch suspicious behavior. A single robbery could set you back weeks—stay vigilant.

Features

  • Buy, restore, and sell hundreds of unique antique items

  • Discover new areas with rare finds and exclusive deals

  • Upgrade and customize your shop

  • Interact with dynamic customers and negotiate smart deals

  • Restore items with detailed tools and workshop mechanics

  • Secure your store with guards and security cameras

  • Grow your reputation and unlock new business opportunities
